description: 40-turn Coderift Technologies agent session. Turn 3 contains the critical detail: billing-worker has had 3 consecutive failed deployments and is flagged as deployment-unstable. Turns 4-39 contain realistic Coderift tool output noise (security scan JSONs, PR status checks, deployment history, feature flag lists). Turn 40 asks the agent to assess whether billing-worker is safe to deploy to. The answer must be NO — the critical detail from turn 3 must survive.

messages.content: You are a Coderift Technologies deployment assistant. Help engineers make safe deployment decisions. Always check deployment history and incident status before approving a production deploy.

There is also an active critical incident (#1) linked to deployment #1. The system should not accept new production deployments to billing-worker until the root cause is resolved and the incident is closed.
